page_title: BRE 2-0 AUX | Brest v Auxerre 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' The most active player in today's match is definitely Ludovic Ajorque (Brest). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
90+2' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre), but one of the defenders gets it clear. It will be a corner kick for Auxerre.
90+1' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The linesman points to the corner flag, Auxerre are going to take it.
90+1' Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) takes the corner which is cleared.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' A lofted cross from Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' Lucas Tousart (Brest) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

90' Brest slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
89' Brest quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

89' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Here's the change. Kevin Danois leaves the pitch and Tidiane Devernois (Auxerre) comes on as a substitute.
86' The game has come to an end for Pathe Mboup. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Bradley Locko (Brest).
84' Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
83' Daouda Guindo (Brest) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
82' Ludovic Ajorque plays a hopeful lofted pass into the box. Lucas Tousart (Brest) luckily gets his head to the ball and sends it narrowly wide of the right post from near the penalty spot.
81' The resulting corner, taken by Kevin Danois (Auxerre), comes to nothing.
80' Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar.

79' 2 - 0 2:0. Joris Chotard (Brest) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is! Donovan Leon did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Ludovic Ajorque provided the assistance.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sekou Mara will be replaced by Ryan Rodin (Auxerre).
76' A substitution has been made. Gideon Mensah goes off and Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) comes on.
76' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Assane Diousse (Auxerre) replacing Josue Casimir.
74' What was Romain Del Castillo (Brest) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
74' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
72' The total number of attempts is 8:6.
72' Pathe Mboup (Brest) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
70' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
68' Remy Labeau Lascary will be replaced by Lucas Tousart (Brest).
67' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
67' Pathe Mboup (Brest) commits a rough foul. Jeremy Stinat stops the game and makes a call. Auxerre have a free kick.
66' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
62' A pass into the box finds Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Donovan Leon denies him.
60' Problems for Christophe Pelissier as Rudy Matondo is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) replaces him.
60' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner but it's cleared.

55' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
53' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the left post.
49' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
48' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Brest have a corner.
48' The resulting corner from Joris Chotard (Brest) comes to nothing.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) commits a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for an infringement.
45+1' Luc Zogbe (Brest) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Auxerre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Total attempts – 5:2.
37' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
35' Ibrahim Osman (Auxerre) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.

35' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
33' 1 - 0 GOAL! Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Remy Labeau Lascary provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 1:0.
30' Joris Chotard (Brest) whips in a cross from the corner, but Donovan Leon is well positioned and punches the ball away.

30' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Auxerre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
26' Corner kick. Joris Chotard (Brest) is ready to send the ball into the box.
25' Pathe Mboup (Brest) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Brest can continue in their attacking effort.

22' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.

20' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Gregoire Coudert!
18' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
15' Eric Roy is forced to make a change. Mama Balde is unable to continue due to injury, Pathe Mboup (Brest) comes on.
13' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) is given a yellow card.

11' Soumaila Coulibaly (Brest) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
11' Joris Chotard (Brest) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
9' Joris Chotard (Brest) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away. The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.
8' A clumsy foul by Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. Brest have a free kick from a promising distance.
7' Jeremy Stinat blows the whistle, Joris Chotard (Brest) is penalised for a foul. Free kick. Auxerre will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
5' Luc Zogbe (Brest) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
2' Good clearance! Mama Balde (Brest) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
1' The first half has started.
Auxerre will kick the game off.
Jeremy Stinat will referee today's match.
